card.name: The word additive in interaction warnings
card.fires_on: The word "additive" right after phrases like "risk of" or "potential for" in drug interaction text. It also fires on "-free" in "drug-free interval".

modes.label: Additive effects
modes.description: "additive" introduces combined effects of two drugs, such as immune, opioid or extrapyramidal effects.
